sbic_east_japan.legal_name: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
sbic_east_japan.chatgpt_event: 2026-03-05 generative-AI/ChatGPT seminar, co-hosted with Hamamatsu Iwata Shinkin and featuring a Microsoft Japan speaker
sbic_east_japan.relationship_to_sbi_holdings: No SBI Holdings affiliation or XRP/Circle partnership established in the official records reviewed.

entity_disambiguation.sbi_group: Separate financial conglomerate and legal-entity network including SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade, SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, SBI Circle Holdings and SBI Startale Marketing. Do not use SBIC and SBI interchangeably.

joint_venture_separation.sbi_circle_holdings: 50% SBI / 50% Circle JV for USDC distribution and Japan Web3 use cases.
joint_venture_separation.sbi_startale_marketing: Separate SBI-Startale JV focused on JPYSC promotion and use cases; SMBC Group agreed to a 5% stake on 2026-10-30. This is not the Circle JV.

circle_arc.gas_asset: USDC; no volatile native token required for transaction fees
circle_arc.exchange_partner_role: Named as digital-asset exchange access partners, not as founding validators.
circle_arc.jpy_sc_status: Circle/SBI statements discuss leveraging JPYSC, but JPYSC public-chain circulation remains future/conditional and JPYSC was not in the launch StableFX local-currency list.
circle_arc.regulatory_status: Circle says Arc is operated by a permissioned validator set and has not been reviewed or approved by NYDFS or another regulator.

shareholder_benefit.eligibility: specified shareholder bands; optional alternative to product bundle

stablecoin_and_network_access.sbi_vctrade_usdc: Current documented inbound route is Ethereum only; no SBI VCTRADE native XRPL USDC route established.
stablecoin_and_network_access.sbi_vctrade_rlusd: Current documented deposits/withdrawals are Ethereum only; XRP Ledger support is planned, not live at the captured product page.

coinbase_rlusd.base_liquidity: Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base.

stablecoin_and_network_access.usdc_xrpl: Circle launched native USDC on XRPL in June 2025; Ripple/Circle described XRPL DEX auto-bridging as using XRP as an essential bridge asset. Actual executed bridge volume remains unmeasured.

jpy_sc.public_chain_status: Account-only at launch; external-wallet/public-chain transfer is future and conditional.

collateral_and_capital.circle_usyc_binance: Circle USYC, a tokenized money-market fund, is supported as yield-bearing off-exchange collateral for Binance institutional derivatives; held through supporting banks via Binance Banking Triparty or Ceffu, with near-instant USDC fungibility. Actual outstanding collateral balances/utilization are undisclosed.

jpy_sc_reserve_correction.interpretation: The Japanese source says 10億円, which is JPY1.0B, not JPY10B. The earlier source-040 note was wrong by a factor of ten; its original record is preserved and this correction supersedes that value. Lending applications are not confirmed accepted loans.

causal_interpretation.sbi_strategy: The evidence is most consistent with a multi-rail strategy spanning XRP incentives, Ripple/RLUSD, Circle/USDC/Arc, Startale/JPYSC/OUSD, Visa card rewards, and SMBC distribution research. It is not evidence of an exclusive choice among issuers.
causal_interpretation.substitution_risk: Arc's USDC gas and StableFX can substitute for XRP as an intermediary in some stablecoin-only corridors, but this remains a hypothesis; JPYSC public-chain use is not live and no route-level volumes are disclosed.
causal_interpretation.complementarity: Native USDC on XRPL can coexist with XRP as an XRPL DEX bridge asset, but actual bridge turnover and depth are not measured.
causal_interpretation.coinbase_position: Coinbase retains substantial USDC economics while adding RLUSD and participating in Arc/Open Standard ecosystems. The RLUSD network support is live across XRPL/Base/Ethereum; collateral availability on Coinbase Global Exchange is still future.

feature_admission.reason: These are institutional strategy, distribution and network-access observations, not synchronized XRP spot/collateral flows.
